name: What kind of preparation is needed before you start painting my trim?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation is needed before you start painting my trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective preparation is crucial for a lasting and flawless trim paint job. Before we begin painting, we will thoroughly clean all trim surfaces to remove dirt, grease, and grime. Any loose or peeling paint will be scraped, and surfaces will be sanded smooth to ensure proper paint adhesion. We will also fill nail holes, caulk gaps between trim and walls, and repair minor imperfections. This comprehensive preparation minimizes future issues like cracking or peeling and ensures a beautiful, professional finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation for trim painting includes cleaning, scraping loose paint, sanding, filling holes, and caulking gaps to ensure proper adhesion and a smooth, lasting finish.
